__provenance__.statement: SYNTHESISED, NOT A CAPTURE. Maps each column the Go join's recording holds (fixtures.json, f16_interleaved_counters.json, f17_upstream_ingress_captured.json in this directory) to where the same value lives once the join is the netflow plugin's (PA5 and PA9 of specs/SPEC-backend-completion-plugins.md, amendment of 17 October 2026). The generic measure output's and parts' names are PA5's, as Lot 2 built them: connection_measure, keyed by measure, and the aggregates' measure_parts, a JSON object keyed by measure name whose value is the measure's parts array (internal/store/schema.sql, "THE LAYOUT OF A MEASURE'S PARTS"). The netflow measure's part is 19 figures wide: bytes, packets, the four classes, its twelve direction states in their declared order, its one marker.

conventions.flow ids: Every flow id the Go join stores (flow_record.joined_flow_id, flow_record.copy_flow_id, connection_measured_volume.connection_flow_id) is recorded as the log_digest of the flow row it names, under the key joined_leg, copy_leg or connection_leg, so that an implementation storing the same legs under other ids compares value for value.
conventions.booleans: loss_detectable, counted_copy and final are recorded as 0 and 1, the Go join's BIGINT columns; after PA15 they are BOOLEAN, and 1 compares equal to true.
conventions.omitted: flow_record.provider_id, collection_gap.id and collection_gap.provider_id, and every aggregate's computed_at, are not recorded: they name the installation's rows or the computation's instant, not a decision.

flow_record.becomes: netflow.flow_record (the netflow plugin's own table, decided question 2)

columns.joined_leg: joined_flow_id, as the digest of the flow it names
columns.copy_leg: copy_flow_id, as the digest of the flow it names

connection_measured_volume.becomes: connection_measure, the generic per-connection measure output (PA5), rows whose measure is netflow

columns.connection_leg: connection_flow_id, as the digest of the flow it names
columns.counted_copy: markers & 1: the marker counted_copy, bit 0 of markers (declared_measure_marker.position 0)

unmatched_record_aggregate_<period>.becomes: the netflow plugin's unmatched counter table (PA4, PA9), one per period, columns unchanged

<family>_aggregate_<period>.becomes: the same family and period; the netflow columns become measure_parts -> 'netflow', the measure's parts array (PA5)

columns.netflow_parts.<part>_direction_<state>_c: element 19p + 6 + the state's declared position (measured 0 ... capture_configuration_unknown 11)
columns.every other column: unchanged: the family's key and its logged figures
